description: L3 wire mapping + round-trip conformance. Pins the enum <-> app-facing-form mappings introduced by the v2 client.proto enum renumbering (TYPE_/OP_/SIGNAL_KIND_ prefixes, moving TEXT/CREATE off wire-0), and that a ModelSync round-trips (encode -> decode) preserving its VALUE. Byte-canonicity is intentionally NOT tested: see obscura-proto SPEC 3 — the data payload is opaque JSON, parsed not byte-compared, and Signal already authenticates the whole message, so reproducible bytes buy nothing here.

roundTrip.name: ModelSync CREATE round-trips preserving model, id, op, timestamp, and data
ModelSync data round-trips by VALUE regardless of key order (not bytes)
ModelSync DELETE (tombstone) round-trips with its op and routing data intact
